author: spleenftw
notes: A Bludit theme inspired by the Blowfish Hugo theme. Five-theme swatch picker (Light/Dark/Nord/Dracula/Catppuccin), sticky ToC sidebar on articles, image lightbox with zoom, image carousel (```carousel fence), tabbed code blocks (```tabs fence), smart sidebar per page type, and clean responsive typography. v1.3.0: SEO (Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD, theme-color, cover preload), per-theme syntax highlighting (self-hosted highlight.js), copy-to-clipboard on code blocks, numbered pagination, inline-SVG icons (dropped the Bootstrap Icons webfont), removed jQuery/Bootstrap JS, deferred cached JS bundle, reading progress bar, back-to-top, randomised sidebar selection, lazy-loaded images, accessibility (skip link, ARIA, :focus-visible) and a print stylesheet. v1.4.0: canonical URL, WebSite + BreadcrumbList + author sameAs JSON-LD, og:image:alt / twitter:site+creator, cover-image aspect-ratio (CLS), heading anchor links, prev/next article nav, related posts, share buttons (X/LinkedIn/copy-link), mailto social icon, PWA web app manifest, 'updated on' date, and outbound-link hardening (noopener noreferrer). v1.5.0: callout/admonition boxes (> [!NOTE]/[!TIP]/[!WARNING]/...), code-block header bar with language label + copy button, visual breadcrumbs, custom 404 page, image figure/figcaption from the markdown title, a mobile table-of-contents drawer, and third-party resource hints. v1.6.0: self-hosted Inter (no Google Fonts), client-side search overlay ("/" key + navbar button), keyboard shortcuts (/ , g h, t, Esc), a tabbed-code copy button, series navigation (series-* tag), and content typography (keycaps, task-list checkboxes, <mark>, external-link icon, footnote/definition-list styling). the navbar search icon only appears once the on-page search box scrolls out of view, and code blocks use a header bar (language + copy) with tighter line-height. v1.7.0: readability pass - underlined in-content links, justified paragraphs with auto-hyphenation (left-aligned on mobile), post-list excerpts from the page description with a 5-tag cap (+N badge), older/newer post navigation under articles, de-duplication of Open Graph / Twitter Card / canonical tags emitted by plugins, cover thumbnails on the post list, server-side width/height injection on content images (CLS), and cross-document view transitions.
